Professional 48 Inch Outdoor Island Chimney Hood with 700 CFM Internal Blower
The ZLINE KECOMi-304-48 Outdoor Range Hoods is professionally crafted from outdoor-approved 304-grade stainless steel to elevate your outdoor kitchen's potential. This hood's high-performance, 700 CFM 4-speed motor will provide all the power you need to quietly and efficiently ventilate your stove while cooking. This Island Mount Range Hood has a ducted vent with easy and simple installation. Often the center attraction of a kitchen, ZLINE Range Hoods can add surprising value to your property by providing an impressive and aesthetic look to your home, excellent ventilation, and additional kitchen lighting.
